notes: The two modal pickers closed themselves mid-flow — adding a series closed the dialog, removing one closed it, the band trio closed it — and every action took effect immediately. Both dialogs now behave like dialogs: EVERY action (add, remove, axis mode, view, fan, lead/lag, hide/show, parameters) mutates a STAGED copy; nothing reaches the chart or the saved layout until OK; Cancel — or Esc, the ✕, or a backdrop click — discards the staging wholesale. A footer on each dialog carries the two buttons and says so: "Changes are staged — nothing reaches the chart until OK." Mechanics: the series mod
